phrases.text: Ne ho fin sopra i capelli.
phrases.meaning: I've had it up to here.
Something fishy is going on here.

phrases.text: Se non è zuppa è pan bagnato.
phrases.meaning: It's six of one and half a dozen of the other.
I'll keep my fingers crossed for you.
You've hit the nail on the head.

phrases.text: Ho una cosa che mi preme.
Non facciamo le cose di fretta.
Tutta la programmazione dipende da questo.
phrases.meaning: The whole plan depends on this.
I leave the decision to you.
We should weigh up the effort.

phrases.text: Mi informo e le faccio sapere.
phrases.meaning: I'll find out and let you know.

phrases.text: Faccio una premessa più ampia, se posso.
phrases.meaning: Let me go back a bit further, if I may.
I don't want to go on too long.

phrases.text: Non posso fare a meno di dirlo.
È difficile da dire a parole.
phrases.meaning: It's hard to put into words.

phrases.text: A essere sincero, non mi stupisce.
phrases.meaning: To be honest, it doesn't surprise me.

phrases.text: Mi commuove più di quanto pensassi.
phrases.meaning: It moves me more than I thought.
I don't understand why it's like that.
I've been thinking about it for days.

phrases.text: Ci ho messo tanto ad accettarlo.
phrases.meaning: It took me a long time to accept it.
You have to get used to it first.
Everyone does it their own way.

phrases.text: Qui si passa presto al tu.
Le differenze sono più sottili di quanto si pensi.
phrases.meaning: The differences are subtler than you'd think.

phrases.text: Non se ne parla così apertamente.
phrases.meaning: People don't talk about it so openly.

phrases.text: La città cresce più in fretta dei piani.
phrases.meaning: The city grows faster than the plans.

phrases.text: Il quartiere ha mantenuto il suo carattere.
phrases.meaning: The neighbourhood has kept its character.

phrases.text: Gli affitti mandano via la gente.
Il cambiamento si vede nei negozi.
phrases.meaning: You can see the change in the shops.

phrases.text: Quel viaggio mi ha cambiato lo sguardo.

phrases.meaning: I set off without precise plans.

phrases.text: Quel paese mi è rimasto dentro.
phrases.meaning: That country has stayed with me.

phrases.text: Mi piace più il viaggio che l'arrivo.
phrases.meaning: I like the journey more than the arrival.

phrases.text: È stato un viaggio che mi ha segnato.
phrases.meaning: It was a trip that marked me.

phrases.text: Lì mi sentivo straniero e a casa.
phrases.meaning: There I felt both foreign and at home.

phrases.text: La lingua mi si apre poco a poco.
phrases.meaning: The language is opening up to me bit by bit.
I think in Italian more and more.

phrases.text: Mi manca ancora il senso del ritmo.
phrases.meaning: I still lack a feel for the rhythm.

phrases.text: Ora capire ascoltando è più facile.
I progressi si vedono solo a posteriori.
phrases.meaning: You only see progress in hindsight.

phrases.text: La lingua parlata è l'ostacolo più grande.
phrases.meaning: Everyday spoken language is the biggest hurdle.

phrases.text: Era destinato a fallire fin dall'inizio.
phrases.meaning: It was doomed from the start.

phrases.text: Non voglio mettere nessuno alla gogna.
phrases.meaning: I don't want to pillory anyone.
The situation is at a standstill.
Now we need to limit the damage.

phrases.text: Dobbiamo tirare il freno a mano.
phrases.meaning: We have to pull the handbrake.
Would you have a moment for me?
I'd be very grateful to you.

phrases.text: Mi dica se non le va bene.
phrases.meaning: Let me know if it doesn't suit you.

phrases.text: Non me ne voglia, per favore.
phrases.meaning: Please don't hold it against me.
I'll be in touch without fail.

phrases.text: È un argomento che chiude la discussione.
phrases.meaning: It's an argument that shuts the discussion down.
The comparison seems lame to me.

phrases.text: Il problema secondo me è altrove.
phrases.meaning: I think the problem lies elsewhere.

phrases.text: Il conto non è così semplice.

phrases.meaning: I'd see it as an interim update.
It goes beyond the time we have.
I'm putting it forward for a decision.

phrases.text: Il progetto poggia su basi fragili.
phrases.meaning: The project rests on fragile foundations.

phrases.text: Più facile a dirsi che a farsi, lo ammetto.
phrases.meaning: Easier said than done, I admit.

phrases.text: Non so più che pesci prendere.
È stato un tentativo alla cieca.
phrases.meaning: It was a shot in the dark.
It means a lot to me.
I think exactly as you do.
I could get used to it.

phrases.text: Non vedo la necessità di intervenire.
phrases.meaning: I see no need to step in.

phrases.text: C'è da restare a bocca aperta.
Di più non si può chiedere.
Questa è la ciliegina sulla torta!
phrases.meaning: That's the icing on the cake! (ironic)

phrases.text: Alla fine si riduce a questo.
phrases.meaning: In the end it comes down to this.
I'm glad to take that up.
I wouldn't want to leave it out.

phrases.text: Sarebbe un passo nella giusta direzione.
phrases.meaning: It would be a step in the right direction.

phrases.text: Io la vedo in modo più pratico.

phrases.meaning: It was an unfortunate way of putting it.

phrases.text: Non ho ancora le idee chiare nemmeno io.
phrases.meaning: I'm not clear on it myself yet.

phrases.text: Mi fa venire la pelle d'oca.

phrases.meaning: I have a bad feeling about it.

phrases.text: Cambia molto da regione a regione.
phrases.meaning: It varies a lot from region to region.

phrases.text: Qui ci si saluta con due baci.
phrases.meaning: Here people greet each other with two kisses.

phrases.text: Qui un quarto d'ora di ritardo è normale.
phrases.meaning: Here a quarter of an hour late is normal.
It's been handed down for generations.
I'd say it's fine like this.
Let's be clear with each other.
That won't be what stops us.

phrases.text: È un punto di vista, semplicemente.
phrases.meaning: It's simply a point of view.
I'd like to pick up on this point.
It's not a done deal yet.
